about: Expected official files for the sources scope of the vault watch (module vault-watch). Rule: on or after alertFrom (local date), if no file whose name matches pattern (regular expression, case-insensitive, matched against the file name only) sits in the course folder's official files (any subfolder or the course folder's top level; not the handwritten folder, not a frozen archive), alert once. alertFrom already contains the grace period for your own upload lag (typically 0-2 days). confidence 'soft' = the name is a guess inferred from one earlier file, so a miss may just be a naming change; the alert says so. Optional per row: remindFrom (YYYY-MM-DD) = alert once more on that date if the file is still missing, e.g. the day before the exercise session; minBytes = alert once if every matching file is smaller than this (a broken or placeholder upload). 'series' generates one row per release: course (id, short name or folder), label and pattern with {n} (plain number) or {nn} (two digits), first_release, every_days (default 7), count, start (default 1), grace_days (default 2), remind_days (optional, days after release), skip_dates (release dates without a file, e.g. a holiday week; numbering does not advance), confidence, min_bytes. Not tracked: items that never land as files in the vault (LMS quizzes, programming-platform tasks, git hand-ins). Regexes need doubled backslashes in JSON. Check every edit with: vault-watch.ps1 -DryRun.
note: Filled by the agent from the course-facts skill and the course cards (release weekday, file naming, your upload lag). Ask the user before changing a pattern beyond an obvious fix.
